triggerRules.combat: only actual successful effect application on a live target; melee damage taken>0; shield full block+eligible living attacker; arrow hit accepted+living target
triggerRules.actions: after server transaction commits successfully; never on local key press
noExtraEffects: full projectile block without living direct attacker
triggerRules.displayOnlyFailure: valid server effect may still play; do not suppress just because material model failed
triggerRules.arrow: one effect result per physical projectile; no elemental arrow trail
triggerRules.dedup: server event identity needed; cannot infer success or effect from uses changes or actionbar text
triggerRules.nativeEffectsPreserved: existing3second burning,60tick slowness and0.65 knockback remain actual gameplay; this burst duration changes none of them
